description: Read the messages for a job. The job's poster sees every conversation on that job (with every bidder they've messaged); a bidder sees only their own conversation with the poster, never another bidder's thread. Every message names its sender and its recipient, so a poster can tell which conversation each one belongs to, their own included. Returned oldest-first. Some messages are written by the platform when something happens, not by a person: each message's event names which (bid_submitted, bid_accepted, bid_withdrawn, job_completed, job_canceled or rating_submitted), and is null for a message a person wrote. A notice's sender is the person whose action produced it.
name: get_messages
title: Read a job's messages
